name: The Capital City
description: Population: Approximately 680,000. Leadership: Under the stern rule of Emperor Baleroth, the city experiences political stability and stringent control, with the Ironhand Army maintaining order. The day-to-day bureaucracy is taken care of by the Lord Mayor Frenzuck. Military Strength: The formidable Ironhand Army has around 34,000 soldiers in the city, the most impressive army of Tanares. The Imperial Capital, situated in the heart of Tanares, serves as Emperor Baleroth’s seat of power and is the largest city on the continent. Most of the population is human. Society is divided by class and wealth, with various factions, guilds, and organizations competing for influence. The political stability is maintained under Emperor Baleroth’s rule, and the Ironhand Army enforces his orders. Entry into the city is strictly controlled, and cleanliness is meticulously maintained in all inner-wall districts. However, government corruption and invasive surveillance of citizens’ personal lives are common in the Capital. The unexplained disappearances of children, particularly in the outer-wall districts, have recently unsettled the populace. Theories range from simple kidnappings to dark experiments, but the authorities have failed to provide any solutions.
